name: Scholze (with Clausen), Lectures on Analytic Geometry (2019/20)
description: Liquid and solid modules over condensed rings; the analytic-ring formalism #661's residual kill_condition names. 2026 arXiv posting of the 2019/20 lecture notes, resolved at spike intake.

name: Commelin, Abstraction boundaries and spec-driven development in pure mathematics (Bull. AMS 2024; arXiv 2023)
target: #660 (which VML tool bites); formalisation record behind REF-liquid-tensor-experiment
description: Formalisation-practice record of the Liquid Tensor Experiment: abstraction boundaries and specification-first development. Published version Bull. AMS 2024 (doi:10.1090/bull/1831) supersedes the arXiv pin in the seed table.

name: Johnstone, On a topological topos (Proc. LMS 38, 1979)
description: Johnstone's topological topos: internal locales and generic reals; the classical precursor of the condensed/pyknotic comparison used in #473 AC1.

name: Chamseddine & Connes, The spectral action principle (CMP 186, 1997)
description: Origin of the spectral action Tr f(D/Λ). Prose-cited today in SpectralMoments.lean and the tensor-product survey with no REF record; this gives PROOF-spectral-action-moment-scaling and WISDOM-003 a citation id.

name: Connes, Noncommutative geometry and reality (JMP 36, 1995)
description: Real spectral triple axioms (reality operator J). Source of the requirement, used in analysis/473-dirac-probe, that a spectral triple's algebra be an associative *-algebra.

name: Bär, The Dirac operator on space forms of positive curvature (J. Math. Soc. Japan 48, 1996)
description: Dirac spectra on spherical space forms S^n/Γ via eta invariants; the spectrum behind the S²(2,2,3) orbifold case in KILLED-locale-forcing-route Prop 15.

name: Camporesi & Higuchi, On the eigenfunctions of the Dirac operator on spheres and real hyperbolic spaces (JGP 20, 1996)
description: Explicit spinor spherical functions and Dirac spectra on S^N and H^N; the general case of the S² eta-vanishing insight and the sedenion Dirac-sum kill.

name: Trautman, The Dirac operator on hypersurfaces (Acta Phys. Polon. B 26, 1995)
description: Dirac operator on spheres as hypersurfaces in Euclidean space; the route to the S¹⁴ ⊂ Im 𝕊 spectrum. OpenAlex dates the arXiv record 1998; the journal paper is 1995 (no journal DOI resolved at intake).

name: Harvey & Lawson, Calibrated geometries (Acta Math. 148, 1982)
description: Associative and coassociative calibrations on Im 𝕆; the associator identity used by PROOF-g2 and the MDCU associator work.

name: Hitchin, The geometry of three-forms in six and seven dimensions (JDG 55, 2000)
target: MDCU R3 B_ψ classifier; G₂→SU(3) reading
description: Stable 3-forms and their volume functionals in dimensions 6 and 7; the stability notion behind the MDCU R3 B_ψ classifier. Journal DOI is from the seed table; OpenAlex resolved the arXiv record.

name: Bryant, Some remarks on G₂-structures (Gökova 2005; arXiv 2003)
target: #661 T2 (torsion classes as 'rule' data the locale forgets)
description: G₂-structure torsion classes and their curvature identities; candidate 'rule' data that a locale forgets (#661 T2).
